scope: A six-fit supervised target adaptation pilot for Faster R-CNN in the reciprocal DARC/MANV directions, using only existing automatic labels and the buffered processed-image inventory.

inputs.base_fit_policy: Use each named completed 42-fit study job’s source-validation-selected portable checkpoint and verified serialized SHA-256. Strictly load the same source weights for zero-shot replay and for adaptation. Use the same-seed, target-trained S0I0 checkpoint for the target-local reference. Record all selected updates, checkpoint hashes and owning job IDs.
inputs.preprocessing: Use the 42-fit S0I0 identity geometry and I0 intensity view for support and all inference. Keep the core detector’s fixed internal image transform, anchor and proposal configuration, and original coordinate output.
inputs.image_id_list_sha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON integer arrays with comma separators, no whitespace and no trailing newline. Preserve the stored order.

support.label_budget: Use all released automatic reference boxes on each of the 16 selected frames. Select whole frames using only site, seed, frame index, and image ID. Use no newly created or human-reviewed annotations.
support.selector: Use split.sites[target].partitions.train. Sort by numeric frame index and then image ID. Cut the sorted list into sixteen contiguous rank strata with boundaries floor(k*N/16), k=0..16. Choose the first image in each stratum under ascending SHA-256 of the UTF-8 string darc-adapt-v1:support:{target}:{seed}:{image_id}, with numeric image ID as tie-break. Save selected IDs in stratum order.
support.target_partition_policy: Exclude target validation, target test and both guard partitions from support and fit. Keep all frozen target test images and boxes for the evaluator; do not use them for model, checkpoint, threshold or budget selection.

fit_policy.method: Faster R-CNN ResNet-50 FPN, verified 42-fit study architecture and inference settings
fit_policy.model_rng: Call the core protocol.set_seed with the integer replicate seed immediately before fitting. The independent stateless SHA-256 batch stream consumes no model RNG.
fit_policy.objective: Optimize the sum of the RoI classification and bounding-box regression training losses. Preserve the core training-time proposal and RoI sampling settings. Keep all non-predictor parameters and buffers unchanged and verify their tensor digest before and after each fit.
fit_policy.budget_rationale: The learning rate is one tenth of the source protocol’s initial rate. Sixty-four steps at batch size two give eight complete passes through 16 existing labeled frames. Freeze the short recipe before adaptation scoring.
fit_policy.schedule: Load checkpoint weights only and use a fresh optimizer. Run exactly 64 optimizer updates at the constant specified learning rate. No augmentation, warmup, early stopping or checkpoint selection. Evaluate final weights.
fit_policy.fixed_batch_stream: For each zero-based cycle, sort all 16 support IDs by ascending SHA-256 of the UTF-8 string darc-adapt-v1:train-order:{source}:{target}:{seed}:{cycle}:{image_id} with numeric image-ID tie-break. Concatenate the 8 cycles and batch consecutive IDs in pairs.
fit_policy.precision: FP32 with TF32 and autocast disabled and no gradient scaler. Record actual optimizer calls and fail on non-finite training loss or gradient.

scoring.hardware: Prefer COCESR 1034 RTX A5000. Replay the source checkpoint and score adapted weights and the target-local checkpoint on the same physical device and backend within each replicate. Record device, software, determinism settings, and precision. A mismatched replay is not eligible for the paired comparison.
scoring.evaluation: Score exact buffered split.sites[target].partitions.test IDs and the full original box inventory. Use identical raw ranking and COCO scoring for all three checkpoints, matching the core detector candidate score floor and maximum detection settings. Do not tune a target operating threshold.
scoring.primary_contrast: For each direction report the three individual pairs, adapted minus matched zero-shot AP50 in percentage points, and mean and sample standard deviation across seeds. Also report AP50:95 and AP75 and the same-backend fully target-trained reference. If showing a gap, compute it as target-local minus the matched incoming score on this replay.
scoring.interpretation: The pilot measures transfer recovery against the released automatic reference inventory under one small label budget. It does not independently establish annotation quality, identify errors in the annotation pipeline, or establish how adaptation behaves outside these two acquisition domains.

pre_score_gates: Freeze the protocol digest and match the supplied release, split, fit job IDs and model configuration to the recorded inputs.
Validate the exact 16 support IDs, disjoint train and holdout partitions, the actual batch stream, four trainable predictor tensors, update count, and frozen other model state.
Confirm all three evaluators use identical target IDs, checkpoint integrity checks, inference settings, and runtime backend. Persist per-frame predictions and evaluation provenance.
